data.acquisitionSummary: Recent Viettel-specialist reporting dated February 2026 describes VTVANG as a 12-month keep-number service for eligible prepaid lines. The same current report gives a 50,000 VND registration fee. A first-party Viettel product page for VTVANG was not located in this review, so the keep product remains specialist-reported rather than provider-official.

keep.action: Recent February-2026 Viettel-specialist evidence reports VTVANG at 50,000 VND for 12 months of number retention without normal recharge/activity; eligibility exclusions apply.

data.chinaActivation: Viettel requires real-name subscriber verification. Current first-party 2026 guidance shows unverified subscribers can have outgoing calls/SMS blocked and overseas subscribers may need My Viettel/Tammi identity remediation. A reliable foreigner-acquisition path is not established here.
data.kyc: Mandatory subscriber identity verification. Current 2026 Viettel notice emphasizes chip-ID/VNeID-based remediation for affected subscribers; foreign-user onboarding eligibility is not established by first-party evidence in this packet.
data.payment: VTVANG is reported as an account/SMS service for eligible prepaid lines; foreign payment/onboarding is not established.
data.wifiCalling: Not relied on for this route decision.
data.roamingSms: Current Viettel guidance for subscribers abroad states roaming must be active to receive OTP, supporting inbound SMS capability when roaming is active; independent long-term OTP reliability is still unverified.
data.holdReason: The 50,000 VND/12-month keep package is current specialist evidence but lacks a located first-party product page, and foreign-user acquisition/KYC plus long-term OTP reliability remain unresolved.
data.tariffSummary: VTVANG reported at 50,000 VND/12 months for eligible prepaid lines; keep as HOLD until first-party product/eligibility and foreign acquisition are verified.
guideSteps: HOLD: treat 50,000 VND/12-month VTVANG as current specialist evidence, not provider-official fact.
Require first-party package/eligibility and foreign-acquisition verification before promotion.
